title: [GMCP 203.045.M] Mastery: Official conformance and ecosystem interoperability matrix
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-045-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Pinned official MCP conformance suites pass with zero expected failures for GMCP as client and server on every supported revision, transport and official extension. Differential tests against representative reference SDKs and major hosts/servers run in both directions on every platform; the published compatibility matrix contains no unexplained cell, and upstream suite changes block release until classified. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
